lockedSettings.title: Locked settings
lockedSettings.description: Wipe Ad settings forced by the administrator (same keys as a settings backup), e.g. {"enabled": true, "gpc": true, "safeMode": true}.

allowlist.title: Allowed sites
allowlist.description: Domains where Wipe Ad is always disabled (added to the user's list, cannot be removed).

forcedRulesets.title: Forced filter lists
forcedRulesets.description: Filter list ids that are always enabled (e.g. "adult", "annoyances").

disableUserFilters.title: Disable custom filters
disableUserFilters.description: Prevents users from adding their own filters and element-picker rules.
